name: The casino (a showcase for the testers, not a level of the game)
about: Javier & Claude, 2026-11-04. Level 5's boss from the team's roster, Madame Chrome, on one casino floor: three cards thrown (she's open after), a low cane sweep (jump it), a cane jab; any combo used twice in a row she parries; three kicks into the cane's wind-up snap it and she's done. Her glass lift between floors comes with level 5's page. Not in levels.json.
